description: Build a draggable 2D (XY) gesture pad — a Container COMP whose pointer drag drives an x/y CHOP of normalized control channels, optionally remapped into ranges and bound by expression to target parameters (e.g. an effect's two main knobs). Add a 3rd (Z) axis via z_target to also get a slider. Open the container in Perform/Panel mode and drag inside it to scrub X/Y live. The pad reads its drag through a Panel CHOP; the u/v drag-channel names are probed at build time (they vary by TD build) and any mismatch is reported as a warning. Leave the axis targets empty to just expose the x/y channels and bind them later with bind_to_channel.

label_x.description: Display label for the X axis (used in the summary).

label_y.description: Display label for the Y axis (used in the summary).

name.description: Name of the container COMP built as the draggable pad.

parent_path.description: COMP path that will hold the XY pad (e.g. '/project1').

size.description: Pad size in pixels (square: width = height = size).

x_range.description: Output range [low, high] for X. The pad's normalized u (0..1) is remapped into it.

x_target.description: Optional 'nodePath.parName' driven by the X axis. Empty = just expose the x/y channels (bind later with bind_to_channel).

y_range.description: Output range [low, high] for Y. The pad's normalized v (0..1) is remapped into it.

y_target.description: Optional 'nodePath.parName' driven by the Y axis. Empty = none.

z_range.description: Output range [low, high] for the optional Z slider (0..1 remapped into it).

z_target.description: Optional 'nodePath.parName' driven by a 3rd (Z) axis. When set, a slider is added (the pad has no native 3rd axis) and its value0 drives this target.

name: create_xy_pad
title: Create XY pad
